name: Chia-Yu Teng
office: City of Diamond Bar, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Chia-Yu Teng has represented District 4 on the Diamond Bar City Council since 2022 and served as mayor in 2025. He is a physician who has practiced medicine for more than 30 years and co-founded Central Health Plan of California. His campaign says his top priority is public safety, and he invited the Los Angeles County District Attorney to Diamond Bar for a community update. He supports the Town Center Specific Plan to redevelop about 45 acres into a mixed-use downtown with housing and businesses. He supports regional transportation projects including the SR-57/60 Interchange Project. On the council, he voted against putting the Measure Q sales tax question on the November 2026 ballot.
